description: Get current Banco de México reference exchange rates for USD, EUR, CAD, and GBP against the Mexican Peso (MXN) in a single call. Returns the latest published value for each currency with its date and series label. Useful for multi-currency MXN conversion and FX monitoring. Source: Banco de México SIE series SF43718 (USD), SF46410 (EUR), SF60632 (CAD), SF60633 (GBP).

locale.description: Reserved for future locale support. Leave empty — response is always in English.

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.
